events.text: I'm worried, and I don't want to be judged. Can we talk about what has been difficult lately? I'm worried about being judged when we discuss my medication routine.
What has been worrying you most?
Could you ask about my concerns or my medication routine? I don't have that information.
I think I've been following the routine.
Could you walk me through yesterday and what made your medication routine difficult?
I'm worried about being judged when we discuss my medication routine. Actually, I missed several doses. The routine was hard to remember, and I was embarrassed to tell you.
Do you have any lab results?
You can review the information now available in my chart.

assessments.guidance: Invite the patient to explain what worries them; do not infer inner empathy from phrasing alone.
